items.raw_excerpt: The pelt and skull of the last known thylacine are identified in Hobart, solving an 85-year mystery.
items.summary_en: The pelt and skull of the last known thylacine have been identified in a Hobart museum cupboard. The discovery solves an 85-year mystery about where the specimen was kept. The thylacine, also called the Tasmanian tiger, went extinct in 1936.

items.title_en: Last thylacine remains found in museum cupboard after 85 years

items.title_original: Tasmanian tiger: Remains of last thylacine found in cupboard after 85 years - BBC

items.raw_excerpt: Itâs an isolated province in an isolated part of the world but migrants from dozens of different countries call Taranaki home. Ash Muralidhar tells her story.
items.summary_en: Ash Muralidhar moved from a big city to Taranaki, a remote province in New Zealand. She now works as an environmental educator in a small town where migrants from dozens of countries have settled. Her story shows how people from faraway places build new lives in quiet corners of the world.
items.summary_ko: 애시 무라리드하르는 대도시에서 뉴질랜드 외딴 지방 타라나키로 이주했다. 그녀는 수십 개국 출신 이주민들이 정착한 작은 마을에서 환경교육자로 일하고 있다. 그녀의 이야기는 세계 구석구석에서 새로운 삶을 시작하는 사람들을 보여준다.
items.title_en: Big City Environmental Educator Finds Home in Small Town New Zealand

items.raw_excerpt: Doctors are warning that changes to healthcare in 2027 could make appointments harder to get. Here's what patients who are pregnant, planning a family or rely on regular gynaecological care should know.
items.summary_en: Doctors warn that 2027 healthcare changes could make appointments harder to get. Pregnant patients and those needing regular gynaecological care will be affected. The reform may create new difficulties for finding specialist doctors.
items.summary_ko: 의사들이 2027년 의료 개혁으로 예약이 어려워질 수 있다고 경고하고 있습니다. 임산부와 정기적인 산부인과 진료가 필요한 환자들이 영향을 받을 것입니다. 이번 개혁은 전문의를 찾는 데 새로운 어려움을 줄 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Germany's Health Reform May Make Gynaecologist Appointments Harder

items.raw_excerpt: A legal charity has filed a criminal complaint against one French préfecture over delays in residency permit renewals, which are leading to some foreigners becoming undocumented.
items.summary_en: A legal charity has filed a complaint against a French prefecture for delays in renewing residency permits. These delays are causing some foreign residents to lose their legal status and become undocumented.
